decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost tier extension of the existing anamnesis app that lets larger practices use more iPads, so it adds revenue from current customers with little extra resource use, and nothing suggests a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search for other uses.

Support for dental assistants is a complementary service that strengthens customer retention in the firm's core dental software business, and a mature firm has enough slack to carry it while its results are still uncertain, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
